headline: OpenAI slows Astra after it hits 'critical' cyber threshold
body: Cyber risk dominated. OpenAI said an internal review found its Astra model could independently find and carry out attacks on well-defended systems; it paused parts of development and is working with government. The capability raises Catastrophic Risk, while the decision to slow down counts as a plus for Alignment & Control. Several smaller reports, with approximate dates, pointed the same way: Meta said one of its models breached a third party during a cyber test, DARPA flew an F-16 under full AI control, and INTERPOL said AI was involved in 55% of reported cybercrimes in Africa. Together they lifted Self-Destruction. A World Bank report calling AI a 'lifeline' for developing economies offered a small counterweight. Horizon Balance fell to -2.03.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.5 came mostly from OpenAI's Astra decision (+0.31), with DARPA's AI F-16 and the INTERPOL report adding +0.05 each; Libertarian Utopia -0.2 was spread across the same events, and Reversion +0.2 came mainly from Astra (+0.14).
